bugs.text: After GAME OVER the banner's next:'results' is never handled, so G.mode stays 'gameover' forever: no results screen, no return to the title, Enter does nothing, and the enemy formation keeps diving and firing at an empty playfield. The page must be reloaded to play again (seen in the 30 s / 60 s / end screenshots).

Every 90th global frame each entering enemy fires with 35% probability, so ~14 aimed bullets are launched at once during fly-in; enemies also aim at the dead player's last position (339) and the player respawns at x=112 into that stream. In the play-test both ships were lost within ~6 s at score 0.

Challenging stage (stage 3) soft-locks: updateChallenging's wave timer never decrements because wave starts at -1 (485-487), all 40 enemies launch at once, fire (353), fly to slot (0,9)=(40,180) and pile up there in formation state forever; the stage never ends and the normal 'all enemies dead' check is skipped in that mode (706).
Only two of the three ships are playable: lives is decremented before the lives>0 test, so the game ends on the second death while the HUD still shows one reserve ship.

The tractor beam, capture, rescue, dual fighter, hostile captive and captive-fire features never trigger: no code ever sets st='beam'. From stage 2 a Boss instead dives to y=112, stops, and is then teleported to the top of the screen (visible pop).

Escort Goei never return to formation. If the Boss they follow dies they hover at its death point firing; if it was rammed near the bottom they can hover off-screen below, where they cannot be shot, and the stage cannot be cleared.
All five entry groups launch at the same moment, and the 'mid' group (4 Boss + 4 Zako) appears on screen at about y=38 on a circle instead of flying in from off-screen.
Formation never breathes; when complete it only sways and bobs 2 px vertically.
A Goei shot while escorting a Boss scores 80 instead of the diving value 160.
Boss Galaga has no wing-flap animation; its two sprites are the pre-hit and post-hit colours.
Stage badges for 5, 10, 20, 30 and 50 all use the same red flag sprite.
HIGH SCORE label drawn with an invalid font argument and centred at x=84 (value at 112); title typo 'MYSTEROUS'; attract screen shows the high score under 1UP.
Escort fire timer starts at 0 so an escort fires on its first frame of escorting.

summary: The file is compact and well organised (state object, fixed-step update, separate render, baked pixel sprites, a decent Web Audio set) and the first stage looks like Galaga: a complete 40-enemy formation with correct types and counts, two-frame flapping bees and butterflies, two-hit colour-changing Bosses, curved entry paths, bezier dives with return-to-slot, escorted Boss dives, HUD, flags, title score table and a saved high score. But it is far from faithful or finished. The signature tractor-beam / capture / dual-fighter chain is dead code because nothing ever enters the 'beam' state; the challenging stage is a guaranteed soft-lock whose enemies fire and then pile on one on-screen point; the game-over flow never shows the results screen or returns to the title; only two of three ships are usable; and a bullet-storm rule during fly-in aims a dozen shots at the respawn point, which is why the automated run lost every ship in eight seconds without scoring. Leftover garbage lines (a self-recursive branch, a NaN placeholder path, an unused mis-parenthesised variable) show the code was not read back before delivery.
